newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shares in DSM jump on 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Shares in DSM jump on 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in Dutch chemicals company DSM jumped 7.00 guilders to a record 192.00 at the open on Tuesday after the company reported 1996 net profits of 720 million guilders.
The company had said in January its preliminary net over 1996 would be at least 700 million guilders.
While DSM's profits had fallen from the 1.07 billion guilders recorded in 1995, the figures were still better than the market had expected, one dealer said.
DSM predicted its first half results in 1997 would be comparable to those over the same period in 1996.
